items.title: nokia-applied-research/AnyJev
items.excerpt: Turn any LLM into a Jev-style decision model: typed decisions, real probabilities, no training. (continue updating)
items.summary: Nokia Applied Research describes turning any LLM into a Jev-style decision model with typed decisions and real probabilities, requiring no training.
items.usefulness: Could help build Python tools that extract structured, probabilistic outputs from existing language models without additional training overhead.
items.to_verify: Whether 'real probabilities' means calibrated confidence scores and what 'no training' concretely excludes.

items.title: yukitorido/short-video-generator-AI
items.excerpt: AI video processing pipeline for generating vertical shorts using LLMs, Whisper transcription, highlight detection and automated editing
items.summary: A video processing pipeline using LLMs, Whisper transcription, highlight detection and automated editing to generate vertical short-form content.
items.usefulness: Could inform building document-analysis Python tools combining speech recognition, language understanding and programmatic media operations.
items.to_verify: Which LLM components perform what tasks and whether highlight detection uses learned or heuristic methods.

items.title: FTC chair suggests AI developers should be liable for conduct of agents
items.summary: FTC chair Reuters statement suggests AI developers face liability for conduct of autonomous agents, pushing back against treating agents as independent actors.
items.usefulness: Provides concrete governance baseline: if building autonomous AI tools, check whether developer liability attaches to agent outputs and decisions.
items.to_verify: The specific scope of 'conduct of agents' and whether liability applies to tool builders or only deployed agent operators.
